thread:
maya: quick sync 1  GA readiness item: pricing kill-switch & shadow billing for cutover customers. need owners and testable acceptance criteria by EOD.

oliver: can you clarify 'pricing kill-switch'? is this a hard block if a routing fallback would incur unexpected >X% cost? or a throttle at the route level?

tamika: proposing two mechanisms: 1) kill-switch (manual or automated) that prevents routing to any model variant flagged as 'high-cost-fallback' for a tenant; 2) shadow-billing mode that mirrors meter events to a ledger for validation without charging. both gated by customer opt-in for private deployments.

felix: for hosted customers we should default to shadow-billing for 72h post-rollout, then auto-enable actual billing if ledger and reconciliation pass. need finops signoff on thresholds.

priya: i'll own the reconciliation matrix and sample datasets. acceptance: shadow ledger must match live meter within 0.5% on token counts and embedding units for 3 simulated customers (free/tier1/enterprise) across 4 traffic profiles. owner: priya. ETA: 48h.

hannah: monitoring ask: create a 'pricing-delta' alert when shadow vs live diverges >1% for 15m or >5% for single-hour. must surface tenant id, route, model-variant, and sample traces. owner: hannah.

maya: legal: any constraints on messaging or customer opt-ins?

legal: legal: must not represent shadow data as "billing-ready" to customers. opt-in copy must clearly state "no charges will be applied while in shadow mode" and record consent in audit log. legal will review final copy within 4 hours of submission. owner: legal.

oliver: technical notes: implement kill-switch as a routing policy flag at the tenant level. policy evaluation order: tenant-override -> feature-flag -> global-policy. kill-switch API: POST /v1/tenants/{id}/safety/kill-switch {"reason":"pricing-spike"} which sets a soft-deny on high-cost variants. must be idempotent and logged. owner: oliver (runtime). ETA: 3 days.

tamika: shadow-billing implementation: fork meter pipeline output to `shadow-ledger` topic with identical message schema except `charged=false`. store shadow outputs for 90 days. export CSV tooling for finance. owner: tamika (billing infra). ETA: 4 days.

filip: (ops-bot): staging smoke: run billing dry-run script `scripts/billing_dryrun.sh --profile=burst` which posts 10k embedding units and checks shadow vs expected.

felix: need customer opt-in UX for hosted: add toggle in account settings (non-default) and record TOS acceptance. for Private deployments, default to OFF and require explicit contract clause. owner: felix (product).

maya: GA acceptance checklist (pricing + billing focused):
- kill-switch API implemented, tested, and documented with curl examples
- shadow-ledger pipeline in staging writing CSVs and sample export exists
- reconciliation tests green (0.5% threshold) across three profiles for 72h in staging
- pricing-delta alert + dashboard created and tested with synthetic divergence events
- customer opt-in UI copy + legal-approved consent text
- runbook for ops: steps to enable/disable kill-switch, how to interpret shadow ledger, and rollback steps

priya: i will validate reconciliation on staging once tamika's pipeline is live. schedule: run for 72h and attach outputs to ticket.

hannah: i'll create a Grafana dashboard tile for pricing-delta and two alerts (warning + P1). link to runbook.

legal: i'll review opt-in copy and return with edits within 4 hours.

oliver: runtime question: if kill-switch triggers while a request is in-flight, what should happen? proposal: let in-flight finish but reject new requests to high-cost variants for that tenant. document behavior.

maya: agreed. document as 'drain-inflight'. acceptance includes tests showing in-flight completes and new requests are routed elsewhere.

felix: cost side: finops requested a 'soft-cost-estimate' header in responses during shadow to give customers visibility: `X-RW-Shadow-Cost-Estimate: tokens=1234, usd=0.12`. do we have bandwidth?

tamika: we can emit estimate. add as opt-in header when tenant in shadow. owner: tamika. ETA: 2 days.

maya: final owners summary: oliver(runtime kill-switch + docs), tamika(billing infra + shadow pipeline + header), priya(reconciler + validation), hannah(monitoring & alerts), felix(product & UX), legal(approval). deadline: owners must post PRs/tasks by EOD today and a staging playbook by tomorrow EOD.

filip: (ops-bot): task created RW-PLAT-7124 "Implement shadow-billing pipeline" assigned to tamika.

maya: one more: Risk classification for GA gating: 
- Blocker: shadow ledger not present or reconciliation fails >0.5% after 72h
- High: kill-switch API missing or non-idempotent behavior
- Medium: header estimate missing

priya: noted. i'll escalate any blocker to ops + product immediately.

maya: thanks all. if no objections i'll fold this into the final launch readiness checklist for billing/pricing and circulate. please add any missing items now.

oliver: no objections. will open runtime PR today.

legal: approving the approach in principle; will review copy when posted.

ops-bot: staging smoke run scheduled at 3023457000

maya: closing thread  will attach checklist and links to tasks in release folder.
